source_origin: Exact original GitHub file reconstructed in isolated CPython runtime. Source baseline Git blob verified by local git hash-object; existing original test file also blob-matched before any changes.
defect: The HTTP(S)-only observation URL scrubber did not recognize protocol-relative //user:pass@host/path?token=... links in page text, title, and control labels; synthetic canary credentials and path tokens reached the model-facing serialized observation.
fix: Mask scheme-relative links only at authority-like // boundaries; preserve ordinary interior // in text and existing http(s) redaction.

limits.scope: Two modules / ten native tests, no whole-repository test or Chromium executed

guardrails: No model call, browsing, GitHub Actions dispatch, main merge, Production deployment, IAM/secret change, paid spend, deletion, public exposure, or third-party site action.
